basics.name: Mansur Fattakhov
basics.label: CTO / Head of Engineering
basics.summary:
CTO and engineering leader with 15+ years of engineering experience. I lead engineering across multiple teams, covering people, architecture, priorities and product delivery.

Led six engineering teams with up to 30 direct reports. Hired and developed engineers and team leads, and made staffing decisions. At RioRise, I was responsible for a platform serving 35,000+ concurrent users; at Dengi Vpered, I built three development teams and owned engineering for two core products.

I remain hands-on: I develop Python backend services, work with Go and distributed systems, and contribute to system design and code reviews. I adapt the balance between management and development to business needs.

work.summary:
Responsible for engineering and technical development of an online gaming platform serving 35,000+ concurrent users. Led six engineering teams across backend, game services and infrastructure, with up to 30 direct reports.

Team leadership and engineering delivery. Hired and developed engineers and team leads, and made staffing decisions. Established planning, task breakdown, technical coordination across teams and release processes. Combined management with architecture and hands-on development.

Architecture and platform development. Led backend modernization and migration of key services to Go. Together with the teams, introduced Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability with Prometheus, Grafana and Sentry. Launched products and services including the store, geolocation and transport services.

Hands-on development. Built the entire game store backend using Python, Django, Django Ninja and Celery: catalog, orders, balances, season pass, payment integrations and webhooks. Developed platform services using FastAPI. Wrote a user event ingestion service handling approximately 8,000 events per second through Redpanda and Vector into ClickHouse.

Scale and results. During my tenure, the audience and game server fleet doubled, while engineering headcount grew by 1.5–2 times. The platform ran on 70 game servers and 60 bare-metal nodes.
stack: Python / Django / Django Ninja / FastAPI / Celery

work.summary:
Led development of several internal systems for construction operations tracking and business process automation. As technical lead, owned backend architecture using Python, Django, FastAPI and PostgreSQL.

Reason for leaving. Following a department reduction, the company offered a similar role in another division. I chose new challenges outside the company rather than an internal transfer.

Owned end-to-end engineering for two core products: planning, architecture, teams and releases.

Teams and processes. Built and trained three in-house teams of 3–4 developers each. Established development planning and workflows, and introduced CI/CD and Agile practices.

Architecture and hands-on development. Designed product architecture and wrote key backend code using Python, Django and FastAPI.

Result. Together with the teams, built a B2C MVP from scratch in a few months.

Reason for leaving. Left following a reduction in product development.

Project work for international clients through a contractor. Worked on backend services, integrations and distributed system architecture.

DoorDash: restaurant partner integrations, menu and order synchronization, gateways and microservices using Python and Kotlin.
Pearson: designed and developed microservices for the AIDA learning platform using Python and Go.
LSEG: financial news processing system using Python and AWS, including integration of a currency pair analysis model.
AstraZeneca: architecture of a computer vision system for image recognition in a laboratory environment.
Reddit: designed and implemented three microservices for billing and advertising automation using Python, gRPC and Kubernetes.
Led development of core electronic signature modules in SBIS using Python. Migrated the codebase to a new corporate platform and worked on module performance, stability and ongoing development.
Led a custom software development agency with a team of 15+ developers. Established planning and engineering processes, owned technical architecture and managed client relationships.

Progressed from developer to lead and took charge of development and maintenance of the BARS Veterinary product. Developed the Python/Django backend, optimized code and response times, and made it easier to add new functionality.
